watches.name: HZ.03 Blue Marble - Labradorite
watches.description: The HZ.03 is a reflection of time and perspective, inspired by the first full portrait of Earth captured in 1972 - The Blue Marble . Beneath its domed sapphire crystal, an orbiting Earth on the seconds sub-dial traces a steady path around the dial, mirroring our planet’s orbit in space. Machined from grade 5 titanium, the 36mm case is lightweight and enduring, housing a precise Seiko VD78 quartz movement. Now available in natural stone, enamel lacquer and aventurine dials, each variant offers a distinct play of light; from the deep shimmer of the stars to the clarity of daylight on Earth. Compact, durable, and effortlessly wearable, the HZ.03 brings cosmic perspective to the wrist; a reminder that every second is part of something greater. Each HZ.03 Blue Marble is a limited run of 100 pieces, and once sold out will never be produced again.

watches.name: HZ.01 Lunar New Year
watches.description: About the HZ.01 The HZ.01 was released in January 2024, and quickly sold out. After delivering the first 500 watches across April and May 2024, the HZ.01 makes a much anticipated return (with a few improvements based on your feedback). What's different about version 2? We've increased the size of the date window by 0.5mm to support legibility We've added a screw down crown, to provide extra security and peace-of-mind in the wet We've added an additional 2 coatings of superluminova to the indices for greater legibility in low-light conditions What remains the same? The same classic design, specifications, and dimensions Our strong commitment to quality and customer service Specifications Case dimensions: Diameter 38.5mm * Height 9.85mm Additional case dimensions: 20mm lug width, 46mm lug to lug (case length) Weight: 45 grams (including attached strap and titanium buckle) Case material: Grade five titanium case Crystal: Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Crown: Screw down titanium crown, signed with logo Lume: Swiss superluminova BGW9 (hands and numerals) Movement: Swiss Ronda 507 quartz movement with day/date function Dial: 2 layer construction with sunburst dial, and raised concentric circle sector dial Designing the HZ.01 The HZ.01 started as a personal project to build myself the perfect everyday watch. In doing so, I defined four key principles that made up the perfect everyday watch, and designed the HZ.01 around these principles. Comfort - through taking advantage of the synergies between titanium and quartz, the HZ.01 weighs in at an impressive 45 grams. With a 38.5mm case size, and less than 1cm thick - the HZ.01 sits comfortably on your wrist, all day, every day. Versatility - the HZ.01 was designed to be versatile, and can be paired with any outfit. Throw on a T-shirt, flannel, or suit, the HZ.01 won't look out of place. Accuracy - with a Swiss Ronda Quartz heartbeat, the HZ.01 is accurate to -10/+20 seconds per month. No need to constantly wind, or set the time - the HZ.01 is always ready for you to grab and go. Durability - housed in a durable titanium case water resistant to 100m, the HZ.01 also sports a strong scratch-resistant Sapphire crystal. T he Quartz movement is extremely shock resistant compared to its mechanical counterparts - so you don't need to worry about your watch.
